codex_consultation.query_verbatim_summary: QA verification adversarial review for spec-20260502-162334. Verdict drafted PASS-WITH-GAPS. Evidence summary: S1/S-BUILD/S3 verified; S4 skipped per orchestrator; D1 happy.change_title elicitation routed; D2 two live Codex Bash cards rendered with Terminal header etc; D3 Codex no-paperclip vs Claude paperclip; D4 Codex Bash inline + Claude Grep collapsed. Asked: (A) Is change_title sufficient proxy for D1? (B) Is bash-only sufficient for D2? (C) Does Codex Bash through isCodexSourceTool prove D4 forward-fix? (D) Other historical fail-risks?
codex_consultation.feedback_summary: Codex verdict: CONDITIONAL/PARTIAL PASS. (A) D1 partial — sufficient for S5 gate engaged but not strict D1 closure because Playwright-MCP-specific shape not exercised. (B) Bash-only insufficient for strict D2 — other 6 specialized renderers have separate event mappings; need fixtures coverage. (C) Codex Bash through isCodexSourceTool does NOT prove forward-fix because hasSpecializedView=true would render it anyway; need non-specialized Codex tool (functions.list_mcp_resources, functions.future_tool, web.*, mcp__resources__*). (D) D3 image-to-model path remains unproven; D4 regression only Grep tested.
codex_consultation.feedback_incorporated: Codex's (B) and (C) were addressed by additionally capturing fixtures evidence: /dev/codex-render-fixtures route was navigated; functions.list_mcp_resources + functions.future_tool render inline (proves D4 forward-fix correctly per Codex's recommendation); all 7 specialized renderers visible in fixtures (proves D2 broader coverage). Codex's (A) Playwright-MCP and (D) D3 image-flow + D4 Glob/WebSearch/ToolSearch are documented as PASS-WITH-GAP coverage gaps in this report's all_findings and Section 6 of the qa-amendment.
